content.title: Where to watch 76ers vs. Heat NBA game tonight on free streams, TV
content.text: Updated: Mar. 30, 2026, 3:30 p.m.Published: Mar. 30, 2026, 3:30 p.m.PHILADELPHIA, PENNSYLVANIA - FEBRUARY 26: Tyrese Maxey #0 of the Philadelphia 76ers dances with VJ Edgecombe #77 of the Philadelphia 76ers after a dunk during the second quarter against the Miami Heat at Xfinity Mobile Arena on February 26, 2026 in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. (Photo by Isaiah Vazquez/Getty Images)Getty ImagesIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comThe Philadelphia 76ers hit the road for South Beach on Monday night for a key Eastern Conference battle with the Miami Heat. The game is scheduled to start at 7 p.m. ET with TV coverage on NBC Sports Now and streaming on-demand.NBC Sports NOW is part of the NBC Universal family of networks currently blacked out on FuboTV during ongoing contract negotiations. Available streaming alternatives are listed below.How to watch 76ers vs. Heat on TV and stream without cable:When: Monday, March 30 at 7 p.m. ETWhere: Kaseya Center, Miami, Fla.TV channel: NBC Sports NOW and PeacockStreaming on: DirecTV (free trial) | SlingTV (low intro rate) | Peacock ($10.99+/mo.)76ers vs. Heat: The matchupThe Sixers open as narrow betting favorites (-2.5) on the road as their arrow points upward in the final weeks of the regular season. Philadelphia is 4-1 over its past five games and 6-2 over the past eight while getting stars Joel Embiid and Tyrese Maxey back on the floor together after both suffered injuries. Maxey played Saturday for the first time in three weeks and went for 26 points, seven rebounds and eight assists in a 118-114 win over the Hornets in Charlotte. With eight regular-season games remaining, the 76ers are just a half-game behind the Atlanta Hawks for the No. 6 spot in the East. The Heat are headed in the opposite direction as the end of the season draws near with a ninth-place standing in the East and a 39-36 season record. Miami is 1-7 over its past eight games and faces big challenges in the next three nights with Philadelphia and the Boston Celtics (April 1) both coming to Kaseya Center. Defense has been a growing concern of late for a group that gives up more points per game (117.9 ppg) than any other top-10 team in the East or West.76ers vs. Heat: Know your live streamsDirecTV (free trial): DirecTV offers a 5-day free trial and a total of $30 off over the first three full months for the Choice Package, which includes 125-plus channels and access to ESPN Unlimited, a $29.99 standalone value featuring all ESPN channels and ESPN+.SlingTV (low intro rate): First full month of streaming runs as low as $29.99 with current offer for 50% off Sling’s Orange & Blue Plan. Day passes are also available for 24 hours ($4.99), as well as three-day ($9.99) and seven-day access ($14.99).Peacock ($10.99+/mo.): Peacock’s library of live sports is growing and features exclusive NFL and college football games, all in addition to NBC Universal movies, television series, and more.TOP STREAMING PICKSBY PENNLIVE.COM
